title: Use the fridge to cool items
description: Use this when the task requires making an item "cool" or "cold."
content: After obtaining the item, go to an open fridge and use the "cool [item] with [fridge]" action to change its temperature state, which is required before completing tasks involving cool items.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put a cool apple in garbagecan.

title: Verify inventory after moving items to confirm successful placement
description: Use this after moving objects to a destination to ensure the action was completed and no items remain in hand.
content: After moving an item to a target location, check your inventory to confirm you are no longer carrying it. This helps track progress when transporting multiple items and prevents confusion about which items have already been delivered.

source.task_query: Your task is to: find two newspaper and put them in coffeetable.

title: Deliver the heated object to the requested destination
description: Use this after successfully heating an object and when the task specifies a final location.
content: Once the object is heated, navigate to the target surface or container and move the object onto it to complete the task.

source.task_query: Your task is to: heat some plate and put it in sidetable.

title: Search multiple locations for required objects
description: Use when a task requires finding multiple instances of the same object type.
content: When collecting multiple identical objects, do not assume they are all in one place. Search different receptacles and surfaces systematically, and revisit locations after picking up an item because the environment may reveal new objects or change state.

source.task_query: Your task is to: find two toiletpaper and put them in drawer.
